name: FIXME
description: With the promise of reliability in cloud, more enterprises are migrating to cloud. The process of continuous integration/deployment (CICD) in cloud connects developers who need to deliver value faster and more transparently with site reliability engineers (SREs) who need to manage applications reliably. SREs feed back development issues to developers, and developers commit fixes and trigger CICD to redeploy.
evaluation_method: human_eval (qualitative analysis of CI/CD/SRE interactions and case-study benchmarks)
reputation: A niche benchmark-style paper on CI/CD and SRE reliability in cloud settings, with limited evidence of broad community adoption.
notes: Appears to be a domain-specific systems/reliability benchmark rather than a standard ML benchmark; no widely standardized leaderboard metric is evident.
